savollar.vinyetka: A 66-year-old man with heart failure has a large right pleural effusion. A thoracentesis is planned in the 9th intercostal space at the midaxillary line.
savollar.savol: To avoid the intercostal neurovascular bundle, where should the needle be inserted?
javoblar: Just above the upper border of the 10th rib
Just below the lower border of the 9th rib
In the middle of the space, perpendicular to the skin
Along the lower border of the 10th rib
savollar.izoh: V-A-N yuqoridagi (9) qovurg'aning pastki qirrasi ostida yotadi. Shuning uchun igna pastdagi (10) qovurg'aning YUQORI qirrasidan, nafas chiqarishda kiritiladi.

savollar.vinyetka: A 72-year-old woman has severe burning pain and a vesicular rash in a band along the left T6 dermatome due to herpes zoster. An intercostal nerve block is planned.
savollar.savol: Why must the T5 and T7 intercostal nerves also be blocked?
javoblar: The T6 nerve has no collateral branches
Anesthetic cannot reach the costal groove
The T6 nerve receives sympathetic fibers only
Herpes zoster always spreads to adjacent ganglia
savollar.izoh: Qo'shni dermatomlar bir-birini qoplaydi va nervning kollateral tarmoqlari bor. Shuning uchun og'riqni to'liq qoldirish uchun bir nechta qo'shni nervlar blokada qilinadi.

savollar.vinyetka: A 25-year-old woman has numbness of the medial forearm and hand and wasting of the hypothenar and interosseous muscles. Her radial pulse diminishes when she turns her head to the opposite side. Neck X-ray shows an extra rib arising from C7.
savollar.savol: Which structures are compressed?
javoblar: Lower trunk of the brachial plexus and subclavian artery
Upper trunk of the brachial plexus and vertebral artery
Median nerve in the carpal tunnel
Ulnar nerve at the medial epicondyle
Long thoracic nerve and axillary artery
savollar.izoh: Ko'krak qafasi chiqish sindromi: bo'yin qovurg'asi pastki stvol (C8-T1) va o'mrov osti arteriyasini ezadi -> Klumpke'ga o'xshash belgilar va puls susayishi.

savollar.vinyetka: A first-year resident reviews a normal posteroanterior chest radiograph with a radiologist and is asked to identify the chamber forming the lower part of the right cardiac border.
savollar.savol: Which chamber forms this border?
savollar.izoh: PA rentgenda o'ng yurak chegarasi pastda - o'ng bo'lmacha, chap chegara - chap qorincha. O'ng qorincha old tomonda bo'lgani uchun chegara hosil qilmaydi.

savollar.vinyetka: A 34-year-old woman has 12 days of nasal congestion, purulent discharge and pain over both cheeks that worsens when she bends forward. Imaging shows an air-fluid level in the right maxillary sinus.
savollar.savol: Why is this sinus most commonly affected?
javoblar: Its ostium is high on the medial wall, so it drains against gravity
It drains into the inferior meatus
It is the only sinus present at birth
It drains directly into the nasopharynx
savollar.izoh: Yuqori jag' bo'shlig'ining teshigi yuqori-medialda, o'rta burun yo'liga ochiladi -> suyuqlik og'irlik kuchiga qarshi chiqadi va osonlikcha to'planadi.

savollar.vinyetka: A 9-year-old boy has recurrent nosebleeds after picking his nose. Each episode stops with direct pressure on the soft part of the nose. Examination shows prominent vessels on the anterior nasal septum.
savollar.savol: What is the most likely source of bleeding?
savollar.izoh: Burundan qon ketishning ko'p qismi oldingi to'siqdagi Kisselbax chigalidan (LEGS). Xavfli orqa qon ketish - sfenopalatin arteriyasidan.

savollar.vinyetka: A 58-year-old man who has smoked 2 packs a day for 35 years undergoes bronchoscopy. Biopsy of the bronchial lining shows stratified squamous epithelium without dysplasia in place of the normal lining.
savollar.savol: Which statement about this change is correct?
javoblar: It is squamous metaplasia and is reversible if he stops smoking
It is invasive squamous cell carcinoma
It results from loss of club cells only
savollar.izoh: Chekish ko'p qatorli kiprikli epiteliyni yassi epiteliyga aylantiradi - yassi hujayrali metaplaziya. Bu himoya moslashuvi va chekish tashlansa qaytadi.

savollar.vinyetka: A 6-year-old boy has recurrent pneumonia, chronic cough with thick sputum, and bulky foul-smelling stools. A pilocarpine sweat test shows elevated chloride. Genetic testing reveals homozygous deletion of phenylalanine at position 508.
savollar.savol: What is the main consequence of this mutation at the cellular level?
javoblar: Misfolded CFTR protein fails to reach the cell membrane
CFTR channel reaches the membrane but cannot open
savollar.izoh: deltaF508: CFTR oqsili noto'g'ri buklanadi va membranaga yetib bormaydi -> Cl- va suv chiqishi kamayadi, quyuq shilliq. Korrektorlar (lumakaftor) aynan shu nuqsonga ta'sir qiladi.

savollar.vinyetka: A 46-year-old woman with long-standing rheumatic mitral stenosis develops progressive hoarseness and difficulty swallowing solid food. Echocardiography shows a markedly enlarged left atrium.
savollar.savol: Compression of which nerve explains the hoarseness?
savollar.izoh: Chap bo'lmacha - yurakning eng orqa qismi. Kattalashsa qizilo'ngachni (disfagiya) va chap qaytuvchi hiqildoq nervini ezadi (ovoz bo'g'ilishi) - Ortner sindromi.

savollar.vinyetka: A 61-year-old man has an acute inferior wall myocardial infarction with ST elevation in II, III and aVF. His heart rate drops to 38/min and ECG shows complete heart block.
savollar.savol: Occlusion of which artery most likely caused the conduction problem?
savollar.izoh: O'ng toj arteriyasi ko'pchilikda SA va AV tugunlarini ta'minlaydi va PDA ni beradi (o'ng dominantlik). Pastki infarktda bradikardiya va AV blokada shu sababli.

bandlar: Skin -> superficial fascia: Camper (fatty) + Scarpa (membranous)
External oblique -> internal oblique -> transversus abdominis
Transversalis fascia (weakness -> direct hernia)
Extraperitoneal connective tissue -> parietal peritoneum
postlar.izoh:
Qorin old devori qavatlari - tashqaridan ichkariga. Laparotomiya, laparoskopiya va churralarni tushunish uchun asos.

1. Teri
2. Yuza fassiya - ikki qavat: yog'li Kamper qavati va zichroq, tolali Skarpa qavati
3. Tashqi qiyshiq mushak
4. Ichki qiyshiq mushak
5. Ko'ndalang mushak
6. Ko'ndalang fassiya
7. Qorin parda oldi (ekstraperitoneal) biriktiruvchi to'qima
8. Parietal qorin parda

💡 USMLE uchun: ko'ndalang fassiyaning yoshga bog'liq zaiflashuvi to'g'ri chov churrasining sababi. Uchta yassi mushak va ularning aponevrozlari chov kanali devorlarini ham hosil qiladi.

bandlar: Oblique passage ~4 cm, above medial half of inguinal ligament
Deep ring: lateral to inferior epigastric vessels, above midpoint of inguinal ligament
Superficial ring: superolateral to pubic tubercle
Female: round ligament of uterus (homologue of gubernaculum)
Ilioinguinal nerve (L1) exits superficial ring: mons pubis, labia majora / anterior scrotum
postlar.izoh:
Chov kanali - qorin old devorining pastki qismidagi qiyshiq yo'l, uzunligi taxminan 4 sm. Chov boylamining medial yarmiga parallel va undan yuqorida yotadi. Chov churralari aynan shu sohada paydo bo'ladi.

🔹 Chuqur (ichki) halqa - kanalga kirish joyi. Pastki epigastral tomirlardan LATERALDA, chov boylamining o'rtasidan sal yuqorida.
🔹 Yuza (tashqi) halqa - kanalning medial chiqish teshigi, qov do'mbog'idan yuqori-lateralda.

♀️ Ayollarda kanal orqali bachadonning yumaloq boylami o'tadi - u bachadondan katta jinsiy lablarga boradi va erkaklardagi moyak yo'naltiruvchisining (gubernaculum) gomologi.

⚡️ Yonbosh-chov nervi (L1, bel chigali tarmog'i) yuza halqadan chiqib, ayollarda qov tepaligi va katta jinsiy lablar, erkaklarda yorg'oqning old-yon terisini innervatsiya qiladi.

bandlar: Cord: deep ring -> inguinal canal -> superficial ring -> scrotum
Testicular artery (from aorta), pampiniform plexus (cooling), vas deferens + its artery
Also autonomic nerves and lymphatics
Testis lymph -> lumbar (para-aortic) nodes, NOT superficial inguinal
Cremasteric reflex: afferent ilioinguinal (L1), efferent genital branch of genitofemoral
postlar.izoh:
Urug' tizimchasi moyak tushishi davomida hosil bo'ladi. U chuqur halqadan boshlanib, chov kanali orqali o'tadi va yuza halqadan chiqib yorg'oqqa tushadi.

Tarkibi:
• Moyak arteriyasi - qorin aortasidan
• Pampinform venoz chigal - moyakni sovutib, haroratini boshqaradi; chuqur halqada moyak venasiga qo'shiladi
• Urug' yo'li va uning arteriyasi
• Vegetativ nervlar va limfa tomirlari

⚠️ Muhim: moyak limfasi bel (aorta yoni) limfa tugunlariga boradi, yuza chov tugunlariga EMAS (oraliqning qolgan qismidan farqli). Moyak saratoni metastazi shuni hisobga olib izlanadi.

🔨 Kremaster refleksi: sonning yuqori-ichki yuzasiga yengil tegilganda moyak biroz ko'tariladi.
• Sezuvchi yo'l - yonbosh-chov nervining L1 tolalari
• Harakat yo'li - son-jinsiy nervning jinsiy tarmog'i (kremaster mushagi)

bandlar: Indirect: through deep ring, LATERAL to inferior epigastric vessels
Indirect: patent processus vaginalis; infants and young males; can reach scrotum; all 3 spermatic fasciae
Direct: through Hesselbach triangle, MEDIAL to inferior epigastric vessels
Direct: weak transversalis fascia; older men; only external spermatic fascia
'MDs don't lie': Medial = Direct, Lateral = indirect
postlar.izoh:
🔸 Qiyshiq (bilvosita) chov churrasi:
• chuqur halqa -> chov kanali -> yuza halqa -> yorg'oqqa tushishi mumkin
• pastki epigastral tomirlardan LATERALDA kiradi
• sababi: qin o'simtasi (processus vaginalis) yopilmay qolgan (gidrotsele ham shu sababdan)
• chaqaloqlarda yoki kattalikda aniqlanadi, erkaklarda ancha ko'p; moyak tushgan yo'ldan boradi
• urug' tizimchasining uchala fassiyasi bilan qoplangan
• eng ko'p uchraydigan churra; ko'rikda barmoq uchi bilan seziladi

🔸 To'g'ri (bevosita) chov churrasi:
• Hesselbax uchburchagi orqali to'g'ridan-to'g'ri qorin devoridan chiqadi
• pastki epigastral tomirlardan MEDIALDA, to'g'ri mushakdan lateralda
• faqat yuza halqadan o'tadi, faqat tashqi urug' fassiyasi bilan qoplangan
• keksa erkaklarda, ko'ndalang fassiya zaiflashganda; qabziyat, prostata kattalashuvi xavfni oshiradi
• kuchanganda chiqadi, tinch holatda yo'qoladi

💡 'MDs don't lie': Medial - Direct, Lateral - indirect.

bandlar: Femoral triangle, lateral to medial: Nerve-Artery-Vein-(Empty space)-Lymphatics = NAVEL
Femoral sheath: artery, vein and femoral canal (deep inguinal nodes), NOT the nerve
Femoral hernia: through femoral canal, BELOW inguinal ligament
Below and lateral to pubic tubercle, medial to femoral vein
More common in women; highest risk of incarceration/strangulation
postlar.izoh:
🦵 Son uchburchagi tarkibi lateraldan medialga: Nerv - Arteriya - Vena - (bo'sh joy) - Limfa = NAVEL. 'Kindikni topish uchun lateraldan medialga yurasiz'. Vena jinsiy a'zoga eng yaqin.

🔹 Son g'ilofi - chov boylamidan 3-4 sm pastgacha davom etuvchi fassial nay. Ichida son arteriyasi, venasi va son kanali (chuqur chov limfa tugunlari) bor. Son nervi g'ilofdan TASHQARIDA.

🔸 Son churrasi:
• son kanali orqali, chov boylamidan PASTDA chiqadi
• qov do'mbog'idan pastda va lateralda (chov churrasi esa yuqorida va medialda)
• son venasidan medialda
• ayollarda ko'proq (ko'pincha o'ngda), lekin umuman olganda ayollarda ham chov churrasi ko'proq uchraydi
• kanal tor bo'lgani uchun erta qisilish (inkarseratsiya, strangulyatsiya) xavfi eng yuqori - kechiktirmay operatsiya qilinadi.

bandlar: Spigelian: through Spigelian aponeurosis between rectus and semilunar line; mostly lower abdomen
Diagnose Spigelian hernia with ultrasound or CT
Congenital (infants): pleuroperitoneal membrane defect, usually LEFT (liver protects right)
Sliding hiatal hernia: GE junction moves up, 'hourglass stomach', GERD; most common
Paraesophageal: GE junction normal, fundus protrudes into thorax
postlar.izoh:
🔸 Spigel churrasi (yarimoysimon chiziq churrasi) - to'g'ri mushak va yarimoysimon chiziq orasidagi Spigel aponevrozi nuqsonidan chiqadi. Ko'pincha qorin pastki qismida, chunki u yerda to'g'ri mushakning orqa qini yo'q. Belgilari: qorin og'rig'i, shu chiziq bo'ylab qo'lga unnaydigan bo'rtma. Tashxis - UTT va KT.

🔸 Diafragma churrasi - qorin a'zolari ko'krak qafasiga chiqadi; ko'krakda ichak shovqinlari eshitiladi.
• Chaqaloqlarda - plevra-qorinparda membranasining tug'ma nuqsoni. Ko'pincha CHAP tomonda, chunki o'ng gumbazni jigar himoya qiladi.
• Kattalarda - qizilo'ngach-diafragma membranasi bo'shashib, hiatal churra.

Hiatal churra turlari:
• Sirpanuvchi - me'da-qizilo'ngach tutashuvi yuqoriga siljiydi, 'qum soatisimon me'da'. Eng ko'p uchraydi, GERK bilan bog'liq.
• Paraezofageal - tutashuv joyida qoladi, lekin me'da tubi ko'krakka chiqadi.

bandlar: Lesser sac (omental bursa) connects to greater sac via omental (Winslow) foramen
Formed by 90-degree clockwise rotation of the stomach
Paracolic gutters along ascending and descending colon
Upright: fluid flows down -> rectovesical / rectouterine pouch
Supine: fluid flows up -> subphrenic + hepatorenal recess (lowest point); shoulder pain via phrenic
postlar.izoh:
🔹 Kichik charvi xaltasi (omental bursa) - me'da embrional davrda soat yo'nalishida 90° burilishi natijasida hosil bo'ladi. Katta qorin parda bo'shlig'i bilan charvi (Vinslov) teshigi orqali tutashadi.
Chegaralari: oldinda - jigar, me'da va kichik charvi; orqada - me'da osti bezi, chap buyrak va diafragma; o'ngda - jigar; chapda - me'da-taloq va taloq-buyrak boylamlari.

🔹 Katta qorin parda xaltasi - qolgan bo'shliq, diafragmadan tosgacha. Unda cho'ntaklar, chuqurchalar va yonbosh (parakolik) ariqchalar bor.

💧 Suyuqlik harakati:
• Normada qorin parda suyuqligi ko'tariluvchi va tushuvchi chambar ichak yonidagi ariqchalar bo'ylab diafragma ostiga ko'tariladi va diafragma limfa tomirlariga so'riladi.
• O'tirgan yoki tik turganda (peritonit, assit) - pastga oqadi: erkaklarda to'g'ri ichak-qovuq, ayollarda to'g'ri ichak-bachadon cho'ntagiga.
• Chalqancha yotganda - yuqoriga, diafragma osti va jigar-buyrak chuqurchasiga oqadi. Jigar-buyrak chuqurchasi bu holatda eng past nuqta. Diafragma nervi (C3-C5) ta'sirlanib, yelka og'rig'i paydo bo'lishi mumkin.

bandlar: Behind and outside the peritoneal cavity
SAD PUCKER: Suprarenal glands, Aorta + IVC, Duodenum (2nd-4th parts)
Pancreas (except tail), Ureters, Colon (ascending + descending)
Kidneys, Esophagus (thoracic part), Rectum (partly)
Injury -> blood or gas in the retroperitoneal space
postlar.izoh:
Retroperitoneal a'zolar qorin parda bo'shlig'idan orqada va undan tashqarida joylashadi. Ular shikastlansa, qon yoki havo qorin parda orqasidagi bo'shliqda to'planadi. Shuning uchun peritonit belgilari kech va noaniq bo'lishi mumkin.

Eslab qolish: SAD PUCKER
• S - buyrak usti bezlari (Suprarenal)
• A - Aorta va pastki kovak vena
• D - o'n ikki barmoqli ichak (Duodenum), 2-4 qismlari
• P - me'da osti bezi (Pancreas), dumidan tashqari
• U - siydik nayi (Ureter)
• C - ko'tariluvchi va tushuvchi chambar ichak (Colon)
• K - buyraklar (Kidneys)
• E - qizilo'ngachning ko'krak qismi (Esophagus)
• R - to'g'ri ichak, qisman (Rectum)

💡 Me'da osti bezi dumi taloq-buyrak boylami ichida yotadi, shuning uchun retroperitoneal hisoblanmaydi.

bandlar: Falciform: liver -> anterior wall; ligamentum teres (fetal umbilical vein)
Hepatoduodenal: portal triad (proper hepatic a., portal v., CBD); Pringle maneuver
Hepatogastric: lesser curvature, gastric vessels (lesser omentum + hepatoduodenal)
Gastrocolic (gastroepiploic a.) and gastrosplenic (short gastrics): greater omentum
Splenorenal: splenic a. and v., tail of pancreas
postlar.izoh:
Qorin bo'shlig'i boylamlari:

🔹 Ventral tutqichdan:
• O'roqsimon boylam - jigardan qorin old devoriga. Ichida jigarning yumaloq boylami (homila kindik venasining qoldig'i) va kindik oldi venalari.
• Jigar-o'n ikki barmoqli ichak boylami - ichida portal triada: xususiy jigar arteriyasi, darvoza venasi, umumiy o't yo'li. Charvi teshigining old chegarasi. Pringl manyovri: shu boylam qisiladi - qon to'xtasa manba darvoza venasi/jigar arteriyasi, to'xtamasa jigar venalari yoki pastki kovak vena.
• Jigar-me'da boylami - me'daning kichik egriligiga, me'da tomirlari bilan. O'ngda katta va kichik xaltalarni ajratadi; kichik xaltaga kirish uchun kesiladi.
Bu ikkalasi birga - kichik charvi.

🔹 Dorsal tutqichdan (katta charvi):
• Me'da-chambar ichak boylami - me'da-charvi arteriyalari
• Me'da-taloq boylami - qisqa me'da arteriyalari va chap me'da-charvi tomirlari; chapda xaltalarni ajratadi
• Taloq-buyrak boylami - taloq arteriyasi va venasi, me'da osti bezi dumi

bandlar: Wall (inside out, MSMS): mucosa, submucosa (Meissner), muscularis externa (Auerbach), serosa/adventitia
Slow waves from interstitial cells of Cajal: duodenum > ileum > stomach
Esophagus: nonkeratinized squamous; upper 1/3 striated muscle
Duodenum: Brunner glands (HCO3-); jejunum: tall plicae, 'feathered'
Ileum: Peyer patches, most goblet cells; colon: crypts + goblet cells, NO villi
postlar.izoh:
🧱 Ichak devori qavatlari (ichkaridan tashqariga - MSMS):
• Shilliq qavat - epiteliy, xususiy plastinka, shilliq qavat mushagi
• Shilliq osti qavat - Meysner nerv chigali (sekretsiya)
• Mushak qavati - Auerbax nerv chigali (motorika)
• Seroz qavat (intraperitoneal a'zolarda) yoki adventitsiya (retroperitonealda)
Eroziya faqat shilliq qavatda; yara shilliq osti va mushak qavatlarigacha chuqurlashadi.

Sekin to'lqinlar Kaxal hujayralaridan: o'n ikki barmoqli ichak > yonbosh ichak > me'da.

🔬 Gistologiya:
• Qizilo'ngach - muguzlanmaydigan ko'p qavatli yassi epiteliy; yuqori 1/3 ko'ndalang-targ'il, pastki 2/3 silliq mushak
• Me'da - parietal hujayralar pushti (eozinofil), bosh hujayralar ko'k (bazofil)
• O'n ikki barmoqli ichak - vorsinkalar, shilliq osti qavatdagi Brunner bezlari (bikarbonat), Liberkyun kriptalari (o'zak hujayralar va defensin, lizotsim ajratuvchi Paneth hujayralari)
• Och ichak - baland, ko'p burmalar, kontrastda 'pat' ko'rinishi
• Yonbosh ichak - Peyer pilakchalari, qadahsimon hujayralar eng ko'p
• Yo'g'on ichak - kriptalar va ko'p qadahsimon hujayralar, vorsinkalar YO'Q

savollar.vinyetka: A 3-month-old boy has an intermittent bulge in the right groin that extends into the scrotum when he cries. At surgery, the hernia sac is found entering the inguinal canal lateral to the inferior epigastric vessels.
savollar.savol: Failure of which embryologic process caused this hernia?
savollar.izoh: Qiyshiq chov churrasi: qin o'simtasi yopilmagan, chuqur halqa orqali epigastral tomirlardan LATERALDA kiradi va yorg'oqqa tushadi. Gidrotsele ham shu sababdan.

savollar.vinyetka: A 72-year-old man with chronic constipation and benign prostatic hyperplasia has a groin bulge that appears on straining and disappears when he lies down. At surgery the bulge is medial to the inferior epigastric vessels.
savollar.savol: Weakness of which structure is the main cause?
javoblar: Transversalis fascia in the Hesselbach triangle
savollar.izoh: To'g'ri chov churrasi: Hesselbax uchburchagida ko'ndalang fassiya zaiflashadi, epigastral tomirlardan MEDIALDA. Keksa erkaklar, kuchanish (qabziyat, BPH).

savollar.vinyetka: A 65-year-old woman has a painful, tender, irreducible lump in the right groin with vomiting. The mass lies below the inguinal ligament and lateral to the pubic tubercle.
savollar.savol: Through which space did this hernia most likely pass?
javoblar: Femoral canal, medial to the femoral vein
savollar.izoh: Son churrasi: son kanali orqali, chov boylamidan pastda, son venasidan medialda. Ayollarda ko'proq va qisilish xavfi eng yuqori - shoshilinch operatsiya.

savollar.vinyetka: A 28-year-old man is diagnosed with a seminoma of the left testis. Staging CT is ordered to look for lymph node metastases.
savollar.savol: Which lymph nodes are the first to be involved?
savollar.izoh: Moyak limfasi moyak tomirlari bo'ylab bel (aorta yoni) tugunlariga boradi. Yorg'oq terisi esa yuza chov tugunlariga - farqini eslab qoling.

savollar.vinyetka: After an open inguinal hernia repair, a 35-year-old man is found to have absent elevation of the testis when the skin of his upper medial thigh is stroked. Sensation over the thigh is normal.
savollar.savol: Injury to which nerve best explains this finding?
javoblar: Genital branch of the genitofemoral nerve
savollar.izoh: Kremaster refleksi: sezuvchi - yonbosh-chov nervi (L1), harakat - son-jinsiy nervning jinsiy tarmog'i. Sezgi saqlangan, javob yo'q -> harakat tarmog'i shikastlangan.

savollar.vinyetka: A full-term newborn develops severe respiratory distress immediately after birth. The abdomen is scaphoid, and bowel sounds are heard over the left hemithorax. Chest X-ray shows bowel loops in the left chest with mediastinal shift to the right.
savollar.savol: Which embryologic defect is most likely responsible?
javoblar: Incomplete closure of the pleuroperitoneal membrane
Failure of the septum transversum to form the central tendon only
savollar.izoh: Tug'ma diafragma churrasi: plevra-qorinparda membranasi yopilmagan, ko'pincha CHAPda (o'ngni jigar himoyalaydi). Qorin 'botiq', o'pka gipoplaziyasi xavfi.

savollar.vinyetka: A 58-year-old obese woman has chronic heartburn and regurgitation. Barium swallow shows the gastroesophageal junction located above the diaphragm, with an 'hourglass' configuration of the stomach.
savollar.savol: What type of hernia is present?
savollar.izoh: Sirpanuvchi hiatal churra: me'da-qizilo'ngach tutashuvi diafragmadan yuqoriga siljiydi, 'qum soati' ko'rinishi, GERK. Paraezofagealda tutashuv joyida qoladi.

savollar.vinyetka: During laparotomy for a liver laceration after a car crash, the surgeon places a vascular clamp across the free edge of the lesser omentum at the omental foramen to control bleeding.
savollar.savol: Which structures are compressed by this maneuver?
javoblar: Proper hepatic artery, portal vein and common bile duct
Hepatic veins and inferior vena cava
savollar.izoh: Pringl manyovri: jigar-o'n ikki barmoqli ichak boylami (portal triada) qisiladi. Qon ketish davom etsa, manba jigar venalari yoki pastki kovak vena.

savollar.vinyetka: A 50-year-old man with a perforated duodenal ulcer has been lying flat in bed for several hours. He develops generalized peritonitis.
savollar.savol: In this position, where does peritoneal fluid tend to collect at the lowest point of the peritoneal cavity?
savollar.izoh: Chalqancha yotganda eng past nuqta - jigar-buyrak chuqurchasi. Tik turganda suyuqlik erkaklarda to'g'ri ichak-qovuq, ayollarda to'g'ri ichak-bachadon cho'ntagiga oqadi.

savollar.vinyetka: A pathology resident examines a biopsy from the small intestine. It shows villi on the surface and coiled bicarbonate-secreting mucous glands located in the submucosa.
savollar.savol: From which part of the GI tract was the biopsy most likely taken?
savollar.izoh: Shilliq osti qavatdagi Brunner bezlari (bikarbonat) faqat o'n ikki barmoqli ichakda. Yonbosh ichakda - Peyer pilakchalari, yo'g'on ichakda vorsinka yo'q.
